content.short: Earn yield on wrapped bitcoin through Starknet Earn, the official hub with curated strategies and one dashboard.
content.description: Starknet Earn is meant to make BTC yield simple for people who have never used Starknet. You connect an EVM wallet you already have, deposit WBTC from a supported chain, and pick a strategy from a curated list with clear rates and terms. Your positions are tracked in one dashboard. Starknet's zk-rollup handles the work underneath, settling to Ethereum. Strategies come from protocols such as Endur, ForgeYields, Noon, Troves and Re7, and accept WBTC, tBTC, LBTC and SolvBTC.
content.meta: Earn yield on wrapped bitcoin through curated Starknet strategies using your existing EVM wallet. Explore Starknet Earn on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
